class.name: DisProbe
class.brief_description: Test helper that checks the bundled open-dis-cpp library.
class.description: Used by the project's own tests to confirm that the open-dis-cpp library is linked and encodes correctly. It has no use in applications; use [DisEntityStatePdu] and [DisNetwork] instead.

method.name: encode_test_entity_state
method.description: Encodes a fixed DIS 7 Entity State PDU (exercise 1, entity 1:2:3, marking [code]"GODOT"[/code]) with open-dis-cpp and returns its bytes in big-endian network order.

method.name: get_version
method.description: Returns the library version text, for example [code]"godot-dis 0.1.0 (open-dis-cpp 1.2.0, godot-cpp 10.0.0)"[/code]. The string is hard-coded in the source.
